name: Instance Encounters
description: Defines how each dungeon encounter (instance_dungeon_encounters) is credited as completed: by killing a creature, casting a spell or by script. Used to track completed encounters of instance saves and for LFG completion rewards.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Encounter id from instance_dungeon_encounters (DungeonEncounter.dbc id on WoTLK).

fields.name: Credit Type
fields.help: How the encounter is completed: 0 = kill creature, 1 = cast spell, 2 = credited by script.

fields.name: Credit Entry
fields.help: Creature entry when Credit Type is kill creature, spell id when it is cast spell, unused for script.

fields.name: Credit Creature
fields.help: Open the creature granting encounter credit (creditType 0).

fields.name: Last Encounter Dungeon
fields.help: LFGDungeons.dbc id if this is the final encounter of the dungeon (grants the LFG dungeon completion reward), 0 otherwise.
